name: streamlink-relay-server
description: StreamLink multistream relay server — one isolated FFmpeg process per platform (so a single dropped platform reconnects without touching the others), quality presets, auto-recovery, scheduling, real-time telemetry, and a multi-turn AI agent endpoint (Anthropic tool use) that observes, decides, acts and reports. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to enable the real agent; without it, /agent uses a deterministic fallback that performs the same observe/act/report sequence.
